paragraphs.en: The skill needs no runtime of its own. Every skill copy ships a small launcher ( scripts/impeccable , plus impeccable.cmd for Windows) that runs the Impeccable engine, a self-contained binary that either sits next to the launcher or is downloaded once on first run into ~/.impeccable/bin/ . Node is only involved if you use the npx impeccable installer, which is a shim around the same binary; the manual and Git options below work without it.
paragraphs.zh: 该技能本身不需要任何运行时。 每个技能副本都自带一个小型启动器（scripts/impeccable，Windows 上另加 impeccable.cmd），用于运行 Impeccable 引擎——一个独立的二进制文件，它要么位于启动器旁边，要么在首次运行时下载一次到 ~/.impeccable/bin/ 中。 只有在你使用 npx impeccable 安装程序时才会涉及 Node，该安装程序只是同一二进制文件的一个垫片（shim）；下面的手动方式和 Git 方式无需 Node 即可工作。

paragraphs.en: npx impeccable install This shows the harness folders or installed CLIs it detected (for example ~/.claude , ~/.codex , ~/.grok , ~/.hermes , ~/.veto , or project-local .cursor ), lets you keep the detected set or customize providers, then asks whether to install into the current project or globally. Use --providers=claude,codex,cursor,grok,hermes,veto and --scope=project|global to skip those choices in scripts. On Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Grok Build, it also installs the provider-native hook manifest for the current project. Veto receives the packaged skill under ~/.veto/skills/ and does not run native Impeccable edit hooks. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Veto, and every other supported tool. Reload your harness afterward.
paragraphs.zh: npx impeccable install 会显示它检测到的 harness 文件夹或已安装的 CLI（例如 ~/.claude、~/.codex、~/.grok、~/.hermes、~/.veto 或项目本地的 .cursor），让你保留检测到的集合或自定义提供方，然后询问是安装到当前项目还是全局安装。 在脚本中使用 --providers=claude,codex,cursor,grok,hermes,veto 和 --scope=project|global 可以跳过这些选择。 在 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、GitHub Copilot 和 Grok Build 上，它还会为当前项目安装提供方原生的钩子清单。 Veto 会在 ~/.veto/skills/ 下接收打包的技能，并且不会运行原生的 Impeccable 编辑钩子。 兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Codex CLI、Grok Build、Hermes 智能体、Veto 以及其他所有受支持的工具。 之后请重新加载你的 harness。

paragraphs.en: npx impeccable update Codex users should open /hooks after install or update and approve the project hook when prompted. Codex tracks trust by hook definition, so updates that change .codex/hooks.json can require approval again. Grok Build users need project folder trust ( /hooks-trust or launch with --trust ) before .grok/hooks/ scripts run.
paragraphs.zh: npx impeccable update Codex 用户在安装或更新后应打开 /hooks，并在出现提示时批准该项目钩子。 Codex 按钩子定义来跟踪信任状态，因此更改 .codex/hooks.json 的更新可能需要再次批准。 Grok Build 用户需要先获得项目文件夹的信任（使用 /hooks-trust 或以 --trust 启动），.grok/hooks/ 中的脚本才能运行。

paragraphs.en: For teams that want to keep Impeccable vendored and updated through Git, add this repo as a submodule and link the compiled provider build into your harness folders:
paragraphs.zh: 对于希望通过 Git 将 Impeccable 以供应商目录（vendored）形式保存并保持更新的团队，请将此仓库添加为子模块，并将编译后的 provider 构建产物链接到你的 harness 文件夹中：

paragraphs.en: git submodule add https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable .impeccable npx impeccable link --source=.impeccable --providers=claude,cursor git add .gitmodules .impeccable .claude .cursor git commit -m " Add Impeccable skills " Use the providers your project needs, for example claude , cursor , gemini , codex , github , grok , hermes , opencode , pi , qoder , trae , trae-cn , rovo-dev , vibe , or veto . The command links individual skill folders from .impeccable/dist/universal/ and leaves existing real skill directories untouched unless you pass --force .

paragraphs.en: Impeccable also keeps its own .gitignore in the folders that hold decision-round state: .impeccable/questions/ and .impeccable/mocks/worlds/ ignore everything in them, and .impeccable/build/ ignores state.json . That keeps new runtime files out of commits even in a project without the block above. A .gitignore cannot untrack a file git already tracks, though: when one of these files was committed earlier, the next roll prints a one-time notice with the fix, git rm -r --cached .impeccable/questions (plus any other folder it names), and writes its roll record to an untracked file until then.
paragraphs.zh: Impeccable 还会在保存决策轮次状态的文件夹中保留自己的 .gitignore：.impeccable/questions/ 和 .impeccable/mocks/worlds/ 会忽略其中所有内容，而 .impeccable/build/ 则会忽略 state.json。 即使在没有上述代码块的项目中，这也能让新的运行时文件不被提交。 不过，.gitignore 无法取消追踪 git 已经追踪的文件：当这些文件中的某个此前已被提交时，下一次轮次会打印一条一次性提示并附上修复方法 git rm -r --cached .impeccable/questions（以及它指出的任何其他文件夹），并在那之前将其轮次记录写入一个未追踪的文件中。

paragraphs.en: When a new design starts, the skill asks the roll API at impeccable.style to deal a hand of visual worlds from the catalog. That request is the feature, so it always happens. Unless you opt out, it also feeds an anonymous record of which hand was shown and which card won, which is how the catalog learns what works.
paragraphs.zh: 当一个新设计开始时，该技能会请求 impeccable.style 的 roll API，从目录中发一手视觉世界。 这个请求就是功能本身，因此它总是会发生。 除非你选择退出，否则它还会提交一份匿名记录，记录展示了哪一手、哪张卡被选中，目录正是借此了解什么设计是有效的。

paragraphs.zh: 在滚动请求及其后续选择中发送的内容：

paragraphs.en: Never sent: your project's name, files, code, PRODUCT.md, or the names of the directions your agent wrote. Committed files such as surface briefs record only a seed reference, a hash of the roll key under a random salt kept in ~/.impeccable/seed-salt , never the key itself. If no salt can be kept on a machine, the brief records no seed at all rather than a weaker hash. Roll keys are 128 random bits. If you pass your own short key with --from , its reference is easy to guess, so do not rely on it to keep that key private.
paragraphs.zh: 绝不发送：你的项目名称、文件、代码、PRODUCT.md，或你的智能体所编写的方向名称。 已提交的文件（如界面简报）只记录一个种子引用，即随机盐值（保存在 ~/.impeccable/seed-salt 中）处理下的掷键哈希，绝不记录该键本身。 如果某台机器上无法保存盐值，简报将完全不记录种子，而不是记录一个较弱的哈希。 掷键是 128 个随机位。 如果你通过 --from 传入自己的短键，其引用很容易被猜到，因此不要依靠它来保守该键的私密性。

paragraphs.en: On Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, and Grok Build, npx impeccable install and npx impeccable update install a provider-native hook manifest along with the skill payload. The hook runs the Impeccable design detector on direct UI file edits and surfaces findings back into the agent flow. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, and Cursor surface findings after the edit (and run a deeper pass on Stop where supported). Grok Build scans after the edit to warm Stop, then surfaces on Stop; PostToolUse stdout never reaches the model.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot、Codex、Cursor 和 Grok Build 上，npx impeccable install 和 npx impeccable update 会随技能载荷一同安装一个提供方原生的钩子清单。 该钩子在直接编辑 UI 文件时运行 Impeccable 设计检测器，并将发现结果反馈到智能体流程中。 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot、Codex 和 Cursor 在编辑之后呈现发现结果（并在支持的情况下在 Stop 时运行更深层的检查）。 Grok Build 在编辑后进行扫描以预热 Stop，然后在 Stop 时呈现结果；PostToolUse 的 stdout 永远不会到达模型。

paragraphs.en: Every command goes through the launcher shipped in the skill's scripts/ directory ( impeccable , or impeccable.cmd on Windows), guarded so a missing launcher is a silent no-op. The launcher runs the engine binary that ships next to it, or downloads the pinned version once into ~/.impeccable/bin/ . No Node or other runtime is required for the hook or the skill.
paragraphs.zh: 每条命令都通过技能 scripts/ 目录中自带的启动器（impeccable，或在 Windows 上为 impeccable.cmd）执行，并做了保护处理，因此启动器缺失时是无声的空操作。 该启动器会运行与其一同发布的引擎二进制文件，或在首次使用时将固定版本下载到 ~/.impeccable/bin/ 中。 钩子和技能都不需要 Node 或其他运行时。

paragraphs.en: In Claude Code, installed command hooks run independently of model-tool approval. The first edit or Stop event can therefore download and cache the engine even if the session denies the model's launcher command. Review installed hooks before unattended runs; to disable all Claude Code hooks for a run, pass --settings '{"disableAllHooks": true}' . See Claude Code's hook security guidance .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Claude Code 中，已安装的命令钩子（hooks）独立于模型工具审批运行。 因此，即使会话拒绝了模型启动器的命令，首次编辑或 Stop 事件也可能下载并缓存引擎。 在无人值守运行之前，请检查已安装的钩子；若要在某次运行中禁用所有 Claude Code 钩子，请传入 --settings '{"disableAllHooks": true}' 。 请参阅 Claude Code 的钩子安全指南。

paragraphs.en: When a new surface gets designed, Impeccable either generates a full-fidelity comp first and builds to match it, or builds straight in code with the ambition written into a development-only direction contract in the surface brief and checked at the finish. Comp-first composes bolder and takes longer; code-first is leaner and faster. The choice covers landing pages and showcase surfaces. App screens and documents are built code-first either way, because they come out better built than pictured. /impeccable init asks once and records the answer as buildPath in .impeccable/config.json :
paragraphs.zh: 当设计一个新界面时，Impeccable 要么先生成一个全保真的设计稿（comp）再按它构建，要么直接用代码构建，把愿景写入界面简报中仅供开发的方向契约，并在完成时进行核验。 设计稿优先的方式构图更大胆但耗时更长；代码优先的方式更精简、更快。 该选择适用于落地页和展示型界面。 应用界面和文档无论哪种情况都采用代码优先构建，因为它们构建出来比画出来效果更好。/impeccable init 会询问一次，并将答案记录为 .impeccable/config.json 中的 buildPath：

paragraphs.en: { "buildPath" : " comp " } The values are comp and code , and nothing else is read. Set it in the gitignored .impeccable/config.local.json to override the team's committed value on one machine, which is what you want when your harness has no image generation. In a monorepo, commit it once at the repo root and any workspace that wants something else sets its own. The choice appears at all only where image generation is available, since without it there is nothing to comp.

paragraphs.en: You do not have to re-run init to set it on a project that predates the setting, and you do not have to edit the file by hand either. Whatever is recorded is a default rather than a lock: every decision page carries a footer toggle, and flipping it binds that session only. Flip it on a project that has recorded nothing and Impeccable asks once, after the round, whether to keep it, then writes your answer. That is the whole migration path for an existing project: use the toggle when the default is wrong, and answer the question that follows.
paragraphs.zh: 对于早于该设置的项目，你无需重新运行 init 来设置它，也不必手动编辑文件。 记录下来的内容是默认值而非锁定：每个决策页面都带有一个页脚切换开关，切换它只对当前会话生效。 在一个没有任何记录的项目上切换它，Impeccable 会在该轮结束后询问一次是否保留，然后写下你的答案。 这就是现有项目的全部迁移路径：当默认值不符合需求时使用切换开关，并回答随之而来的问题。

paragraphs.en: Impeccable includes a standalone CLI for detecting anti-patterns without an AI harness. npx impeccable is a small shim that runs the same engine binary the skill uses (installed as a platform-specific optional dependency, or fetched once into ~/.impeccable/bin/ ); Node is needed only for npx itself, and you can also download the binary directly and put it on your PATH.
paragraphs.zh: Impeccable 包含一个独立的 CLI，用于在没有 AI 框架的情况下检测反模式。npx impeccable 是一个小型垫片（shim），它运行与技能相同的引擎二进制文件（作为平台特定的可选依赖项安装，或一次性获取到 ~/.impeccable/bin/ ）；只有 npx 本身需要 Node，你也可以直接下载该二进制文件并将其放入 PATH 中。

paragraphs.en: npx impeccable detect src/ # scan a directory npx impeccable detect index.html # scan an HTML file npx impeccable detect https://example.com # scan a URL (uses an installed Chrome, Chromium, or Edge) npx impeccable detect --json . # CI-friendly JSON output npx impeccable detect --github src/ # GitHub Actions annotations on stdout npx impeccable detect --list-rules # catalog of detector rule ids, names, and descriptions npx impeccable detect --no-config src/ # raw scan, ignoring project config/context npx impeccable ignores list # show detector ignores npx impeccable ignores add-file " src/legacy/** " npx impeccable ignores add-value overused-font Inter --reason " Brand font " The detector catches 62 deterministic issues across AI slop (side-tab borders, purple gradients, bounce easing, dark glows) and general design quality (line length, cramped padding, small touch targets, skipped headings, and more).
paragraphs.zh:
npx impeccable detect src/ # 扫描一个目录
npx impeccable detect index.html # 扫描一个 HTML 文件
npx impeccable detect https://example.com # 扫描一个 URL（使用已安装的 Chrome、Chromium 或 Edge）
npx impeccable detect --json . # 适合 CI 的 JSON 输出
npx impeccable detect --github src/ # 在 stdout 上输出 GitHub Actions 注解
npx impeccable detect --list-rules # 检测器规则的 id、名称和描述目录
npx impeccable detect --no-config src/ # 原始扫描，忽略项目配置/上下文
npx impeccable ignores list # 查看检测器忽略项
npx impeccable ignores add-file " src/legacy/** "
npx impeccable ignores add-value overused-font Inter --reason " 品牌字体 "

检测器可以捕获 62 类确定性问题，涵盖 AI 垃圾风格（侧边标签边框、紫色渐变、弹跳缓动、暗色光晕）和通用设计质量（行长度、局促的内边距、过小的触控目标、跳级的标题层级等）。

paragraphs.en: Human-readable findings are diagnostics written to stderr, so redirect them with 2> findings.txt . Use --json for machine-readable results on stdout, or --github for GitHub Actions annotations (one workflow command per finding). GitHub displays at most 10 annotations of each type per step and 50 per job, and the rest stay in the log; findings from the HTML engine may carry no line number, so they annotate the file. --list-rules prints the detector catalog to stdout and does not scan. Exit 0 means the scan completed without primary findings, exit 2 means it completed with primary findings, and exit 1 means at least one requested target could not be scanned; operational failure takes precedence for a partial multi-target scan. URL scans inspect the rendered DOM, computed layout, and accessible linked stylesheets; browser security still prevents reading cross-origin CSS without CORS. A clean detector run is evidence, not proof of visual or accessibility quality: it does not replace inspecting the rendered experience across relevant viewports.
paragraphs.zh: 人类可读的诊断结果会写入 stderr，因此请使用 2> findings.txt 将其重定向。 使用 --json 可在 stdout 上获得机器可读的结果，或使用 --github 生成 GitHub Actions 注释（每条发现对应一条工作流命令）。 GitHub 每个步骤最多显示每种类型 10 条注释、每个作业最多 50 条，其余保留在日志中；来自 HTML 引擎的发现可能没有行号，因此会注释到文件。 --list-rules 将检测器目录打印到 stdout，且不执行扫描。 退出码 0 表示扫描完成且没有主要发现，退出码 2 表示扫描完成但存在主要发现，退出码 1 表示至少有一个请求的目标无法被扫描；对于部分完成的多目标扫描，操作失败优先。 URL 扫描会检查渲染后的 DOM、计算后的布局以及可访问的链接样式表；浏览器安全机制仍然会阻止在没有 CORS 的情况下读取跨域 CSS。 检测器运行干净是一种证据，而非视觉或无障碍质量的证明：它不能替代在相关视口下对渲染体验的检查。

paragraphs.en: For a waiver that should travel with one file instead of the repo config, add an inline comment in the file: <!-- impeccable-disable overused-font: exported brand doc --> . The marker works in any comment syntax, scopes to the whole file (or one line with impeccable-disable-line / impeccable-disable-next-line ), and is bypassed by --no-inline-ignores or --no-config .
paragraphs.zh: 对于应当随单个文件（而非仓库配置）一起生效的豁免，可在该文件中添加行内注释：<!-- impeccable-disable overused-font: exported brand doc --> 。 该标记适用于任何注释语法，作用范围为整个文件（或通过 impeccable-disable-line / impeccable-disable-next-line 仅作用于一行），并且会被 --no-inline-ignores 或 --no-config 绕过。
